programme: Alexander structures · classical certificates and matching heights
title: Matching states either continue forever or have an exact finite height

plain_language.question: What exactly separates an infinite pattern-matching continuation from one that must stop?
plain_language.what_we_learned: Classical rank and pruning methods give an exact answer on reachable states. Under finite branching, every state either continues forever or has an attained longest continuation; complete finite duplication preserves the corresponding finite heights.
plain_language.what_it_lets_someone_do: Use an exact source-specific certificate and identify information that matching heights retain or omit, without inventing a new rank theory.
plain_language.what_cannot_conclude: This is not a terminating decision procedure for arbitrary infinite inputs, a rank hierarchy distinguishing every avoiding population or an established new ordinal theorem.

exact_statement_and_scope: For a labelled graph and fixed infinite word s, use reachable vertex/phase states (v,k) witnessed by a path spelling the first k letters. Avoidance is equivalent to well-foundedness of forward continuation and to a decreasing ordinal certificate, without a finite-branching premise. With finite per-label children, natural certificates suffice; states surviving all finite successor-pruning rounds form exactly the infinite-continuation core and the greatest successor fixed point. Its complement is forward closed and well-founded. Each such mortal state has a pointwise least natural height h, equal to an attained maximum number of further matching edges, survives precisely n≤h and is removed at h+1; other states may realize the word, so global avoidance is not assumed for this dichotomy. A phase-zero state survives iff its start realizes the full target. A separate complete positive finite-fibre blow-up preserves and reflects reachable phases and every finite continuation length, and transports least attained natural heights through the actual projection. Its avoiding-population endpoint derives the needed hypotheses. This complete blow-up is not terminal cloning and need not preserve exact parent counts. The written composition with countable-host obstruction and written live-core/infinite-tail transport are not separately named combined Lean endpoints.
